---
title: "Power Analysis Dashboard"
format: html
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(plotly)
library(jsonlite)

make_params_label <- function(params_json) {
  params <- fromJSON(gsub('\\', '"', params_json, fixed = TRUE))
  if (length(params) == 0) return("")
  paste(names(params), unlist(params), sep = "=", collapse = ", ")
}

make_method_label <- function(method, method_params_json) {
  lab <- make_params_label(method_params_json)
  if (nzchar(lab)) paste0(method, " (", lab, ")") else method
}

make_scenario_label <- function(scenario, scenario_params_json) {
  lab <- make_params_label(scenario_params_json)
  if (nzchar(lab)) paste0("Scenario ", scenario, " (", lab, ")") else paste0("Scenario ", scenario)
}

plot_type1 <- function(data) {
  p <- data |>
    mutate(
      shape    = ifelse(err_type == "exponential", 17, 16),
      err_type = fct_relevel(err_type, "normal")
    ) |>
    arrange(method_label, err_type) |>
    ggplot(aes(
      x     = n,
      y     = metric_val,
      color = method_label,
      shape = I(shape),
      text  = paste0(
        scenario_label, "<br>",
        method_label, "<br>",
        err_type, "<br>",
        "rejection rate: ", metric_val
      )
    )) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.10, linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(y = "Rejection Rate", x = "Sample Size", color = "Method") +
    theme_bw()

  pl <- ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")

  # Split 4 method traces into two columns by assigning to legend / legend2
  method_idx <- which(vapply(pl$x$data, function(t) nzchar(t$name), logical(1)))
  for (i in seq_along(method_idx)) {
    pl$x$data[[method_idx[i]]]$legend <- if (i <= 2) "legend" else "legend2"
  }

  pl$x$layout$legend <- list(
    title       = list(text = ""),
    orientation = "h",
    x = 0,   xanchor = "left",
    y = -0.2
  )
  pl$x$layout$legend2 <- list(
    orientation = "h",
    x = 0.5, xanchor = "left",
    y = -0.2
  )
  pl
}

results <- read_csv(
  here::here("data/results.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    method_label   = map2_chr(method,   method_params,   make_method_label),
    scenario_label = map2_chr(scenario, scenario_params, make_scenario_label)
  )

# cov_type is irrelevant (AR1 == compound), drop duplicates
type1_data <- results |>
  filter(metric == "power", r == 0) |>
  distinct(n, err_type, method_label, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(n = factor(n))

power_data <- results |>
  filter(metric == "power")

power_p2 <- power_data |> filter(p == 2, amp == 1)
power_pp  <- power_data |> filter(p >  2, amp == 1)

n_choices      <- sort(unique(power_data$n))
all_methods    <- sort(unique(results$method))
default_methods <- c("z.test.gaussian", "z.test.oracle.kappa", "bs.multiplier", "bs.parametric")
scenarios <- sort(unique(power_p2$scenario_label))

plot_power <- function(data, by_p = FALSE) {
  p <- data |>
    mutate(shape = ifelse(err_type == "exponential", 17, 16)) |>
    arrange(method_label, err_type, r) |>
    ggplot(aes(
      x        = r,
      y        = metric_val,
      color    = method_label,
      group    = interaction(method_label, err_type),
      linetype = err_type,
      shape    = I(shape),
      text     = paste0(
        scenario_label, "<br>",
        method_label, "<br>",
        err_type, "<br>",
        "r = ", r, "<br>",
        "power: ", metric_val
      )
    )) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.10, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(normal = "solid", exponential = "dashed"), guide = "none") +
    { if (by_p)
        facet_grid(rows = vars(cov_type), cols = vars(p), labeller = label_both)
      else
        facet_wrap(vars(cov_type), labeller = label_both) } +
    labs(y = "Power", x = "Correlation (r)", color = "Method") +
    theme_bw()

  pl <- ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")

  method_idx <- which(vapply(pl$x$data, function(t) nzchar(t$name), logical(1)))
  half <- ceiling(length(method_idx) / 2)
  for (i in seq_along(method_idx)) {
    pl$x$data[[method_idx[i]]]$legend <- if (i <= half) "legend" else "legend2"
  }

  pl$x$layout$legend <- list(
    title       = list(text = ""),
    orientation = "h",
    x = 0,   xanchor = "left",
    y = -0.2
  )
  pl$x$layout$legend2 <- list(
    orientation = "h",
    x = 0.5, xanchor = "left",
    y = -0.2
  )
  pl
}
```

```{r}
selectInput(
  "n_sel", "Sample Size (n):",
  choices  = n_choices,
  selected = n_choices[1]
)
checkboxGroupInput(
  "err_types", "Error Type:",
  choices  = c("normal", "exponential"),
  selected = "normal",
  inline   = TRUE
)
checkboxGroupInput(
  "methods", "Methods:",
  choices  = all_methods,
  selected = default_methods,
  inline   = TRUE
)
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r}
plotlyOutput("t1_plot", height = "100vh")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
output$t1_plot <- renderPlotly({
  plot_type1(type1_data |> filter(err_type %in% input$err_types, method %in% input$methods))
})
```

## Power

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
for (sc in scenarios) {
  cat("##", sc, "\n\n")
  cat(as.character(plotlyOutput(paste0("pw_", make.names(sc)), height = "100vh")))
  if (any(power_pp$scenario_label == sc)) {
    cat("\n\n")
    cat(as.character(plotlyOutput(paste0("pwp_", make.names(sc)), height = "100vh")))
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}
cat(":::\n")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
lapply(scenarios, function(sc) {
  local({
    s <- sc
    output[[paste0("pw_", make.names(s))]] <- renderPlotly({
      n_val <- as.integer(input$n_sel)
      plot_power(power_p2 |> filter(scenario_label == s, n == n_val, err_type %in% input$err_types, method %in% input$methods))
    })
    if (any(power_pp$scenario_label == s)) {
      output[[paste0("pwp_", make.names(s))]] <- renderPlotly({
        n_val <- as.integer(input$n_sel)
        plot_power(power_pp |> filter(scenario_label == s, n == n_val, err_type %in% input$err_types, method %in% input$methods), by_p = TRUE)
      })
    }
  })
})
```
